whatThisIs: Families the decision owner held pending a specific correction. Each is unapproved until the named correction is made and, where the owner said so, independently re-verified. The packet shape is not in question; its content or its confirmation is.
howItIsApplied: generate.mjs reads this file and treats a live correction as an open legal input, so the family cannot be COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN and cannot enter a route cohort. Payment was already fail-closed and stays so.
liftedHow: The named correction is made, the family is rebuilt, and an independent verifier who is neither its builder nor its repairer reads it again. Removing the entry without that is how an owner withholding gets lost.

corrections.theQuestionAsked: The design record's own release blocker leaves open whether an official form governs this filing. If the issuing court or agency publishes one, it governs by localFormOverride and this composed instrument becomes a covering document or is withdrawn. Is the composed instrument the approved output, and what happens to it when the official form is located?
corrections.ownerDecision: THE OFFICIAL FORM GOVERNS WHEN ONE IS MANDATORY. A composed instrument may be used only when no mandatory official form applies. If the official form is located, use it; retain the composed document only as a legally appropriate cover or support document, otherwise withdraw it. No commercial approval until form status is resolved.
corrections.correctionRequired: Resolve whether a mandatory official form governs this filing. If one is located it governs and the composed instrument is retained only as a legally appropriate cover or support document, or withdrawn. No commercial approval until form status is resolved.

corrections.theQuestion: Does CR-65 have to be sworn before a notary? The packet says yes and the held record says the requirement is not established, and the two cannot both stand in front of a participant.

whatThePacketSays.text: Complete the participant signature only after every fact and attachment is complete, and sign under oath before a notary or other authorized officer.

whatTheRecordSays.text: The source review does not state a notarization requirement for CR-65.

corrections.whyNeitherALaneNorICanSettleIt: VF09 read CR-65 page 6 and reports its printed face is a JURAT. If that is right, deleting the sentence to match the memo would leave a participant filing an unsworn affidavit, which is a worse defect than the one being corrected -- and the memo's own wording is that the SOURCE REVIEW does not state a requirement, which is not the same as the form not carrying one. The safe correction depends on what the form's face actually requires, and that is a legal reading of a sworn document.

whatIMeasuredMyself.note: VF09 reported the sentence surviving in three of four Alabama guides. I counted one of six CR-65 families carrying any notary or notarization mention; the other Alabama hits are in al-olr and the uncharged-arrest agency-record challenge, which are different forms on different routes. I am recording my own count and flagging that it does not match, rather than relaying a number I could not reproduce.

theTwoAnswers.cr65IsSworn: The memo's notarization field is corrected to record what the form's face requires, and the sentence stays. The other five CR-65 guides are then MISSING it, which is the defect to repair.
theTwoAnswers.cr65IsNotSworn: The sentence is removed from the one guide that carries it, and the packet stops directing a step the form does not require.

corrections.whatIsNotAtRiskMeanwhile: No Alabama family is terminal or sellable: two are FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED on a separate unmarked-selection defect and four cannot be rebuilt at all because CR-65's custody is not mounted here.
